query.description: LogQL / Logging query / CloudWatch filter pattern (e.g. ERROR or { $.level = "error" }) / query_string.

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous logs_tail call. Omit on the first call.

since.description: First call only: also return the newest entries since this time, e.g. -5m.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for new entries before returning an empty page.
